stemMarkdown: In a race of 500 m, the ratio of speeds of A and B is 11:3. If they start together, by what distance (in m) does A win when A finishes the race? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 500 m, B covers $\dfrac{3}{11} \times 500 = 136.36$ m (same time, speeds proportional to distance covered). A wins by $= 500 - 136.36 = 363.64$ m.
